## City Streets

I am interested in how much one can learn about a city just by looking at its
streets. The starting point is
[Geoff Boeing](https://geoffboeing.com/)'s work on
[urban street network orientation](https://geoffboeing.com/2019/09/urban-street-network-orientation/),
which measures a city's grid order by the entropy of its street bearings.

City Streets extends that idea to three dimensions: each city's street network
becomes a probability measure on $\mathbb{RP}^2$, crossing compass bearing with
grade. From those measures it computes rotation-aligned Wasserstein and
Jensen–Shannon distances between 84 world cities, along with comparable measures
of hilliness, walkability, on-street parking, and staircase streets. Built as a
Julia package with an interactive dashboard.

[Open the dashboard →](/city-streets/) ·
[More about the project →](projects/city-streets.qmd)
:::

::: {.section-block}
## Leatherwork

I hand-make small goods out of vegetable-tanned leather — wallets, belts, and
the like — cutting, saddle-stitching, and finishing each piece by hand. It is
also part of why I like being in Chicago, home of the
[Horween Leather Company](https://www.horween.com/).

## Boots

I wear and care for heritage boots, and I am interested in patina — how a pair
takes on the shape and markings of the person wearing it over years of wear.
